basic_details.job_title: SNDT Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: SNDT Women's University invites applications on plain paper for 01 temporary post of Technical Assistant on a purely contractual basis for 06 months at its Churchgate Campus, Mumbai. Candidates must submit their application along with self-attested certificates to the Office of the Registrar, S.N.D.T. Women's University, 01, Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Road, Churchgate Campus, Mumbai – 400 020 on or before 28 October 2026 by 05:00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: About SNDT Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: SNDT Women's University (श्रीमती ना. दा. ठाकरसी महिला विद्यापीठ), established in 1916, is located at 1, Nathibai Thackersey Road, Mumbai – 400 020 (Phone: +91 22 2203 1879, Fax: +91 22 2201 8226, Telegram: UNIWOMEN, Website: sndt.ac.in). The university operates multiple campuses, including the Churchgate Campus in Mumbai, and administers educational and administrative appointments through the Office of the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must prepare an application on plain paper stating their name, address, contact number, educational qualifications, experience, and the post applied for. The completed application, along with self-attested copies of certificates, must be submitted to the following address on or before 28 October 2026 by 05:00 p.m.: Office of the Registrar, S.N.D.T. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted for 01 contractual vacancy of Technical Assistant at Churchgate Campus on a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs. 27,450/- for a period of 06 months. B.Sc. (Electronics / Computer or allied branches) from any Recognized Statutory University, or Diploma (Electronics / Computer or allied branches) from any Recognized Statutory University / Bodies. Knowledge of Marathi & English Language essential. Knowledge of Computer is essential. The prescribed age criteria for the post are as follows: General Category: Not less than 18 years of age and not more than 38 years of age. Backward Classes: Not more than 43 years of age. Candidates should verify the official notification for further details regarding discipline-specific eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under SNDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 temporary vacancy for the post of Technical Assistant at the Churchgate Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SNDT Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 28 October 2026 on or before 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for SNDT Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. or Diploma in Electronics, Computer, or allied branches from a recognised university or statutory body, along with essential knowledge of Marathi, English, and computers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SNDT Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the General Category must be between 18 and 38 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age relaxation for Backward Classes?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to Backward Classes can apply up to a maximum age of 43 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary or honorarium for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 27,450/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is the SNDT Technical Assistant post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is purely contractual for a duration of 06 months.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for SNDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit an application on plain paper containing their details along with self-attested copies of certificates to the Office of the Registrar at the Churchgate Campus, Mumbai by 28 October 2026.
